title: Momcozy No WiFi Baby Monitor,5.5'' 1080P Full HD Screen,Smart Notifications
bullets: 【1080P 5.5 inch HD Screen】Experience every detail with crystal-clear precision on the BM03(black) baby monitor's true 1080P Full HD resolution and 5.5-inch large screen. Whether you're working, exercising, or simply relaxing, feel like you're right by your baby's side with peace of mind at a glance.

【Non-WiFi Reliable Connection】Enjoy a strong and secure connection up to 1640 feet (500m) with the non-WiFi baby monitor. Featuring an FHSS closed-circuit system, your family's privacy is protected, as only you can access the feed. No WiFi needed, ensuring private, secure access only for your family.
【Customizable Danger Zone Alert】Set a virtual safety zone in parent unit and get instant alerts if baby leaves the designated area. Respond quickly to potential risks for added peace of mind.
【Smart Motion Detection】Receive real-time parent unit notifications when baby moves or there is a potential sleep risk. Stay informed and confident your baby is safe at all times.

【5800mAh Long Battery for All-day Protection】BM03 baby monitor continuously for up to 120 hours in ECO mode and 5 days in ECO mode with the powerful 5800mAh battery. Stay protected day and night without worrying about power interruptions.

【Super Night Vision & VOX Alerts】See clearly up to 8 meters in total darkness with infrared night vision with Momcozy baby monitor with camera and audio. Screen auto-activates with VOX sound detection, keeping you connected even in the dark.
